title: Catalog quantization provenance, staged rollout & shadow rollback playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: define and implement a reproducible provenance + staged rollout playbook for per-model quantization defaults in the model catalog. This ticket captures design decisions, data and telemetry gating, the shadow-validation harness, and the automated rollback criteria we will use when promoting FP8/INT8 defaults to production.

Scope: store quantization profile provenance (source model commit, quant pipeline config, calibration dataset fingerprint, calibration seed, calibration artifacts link) in the catalog entry; integrate telemetry gates (token-level token-accuracy delta, perplexity drift by prompt-class, latency/regression SLOs); implement a shadow validation job that runs candidate quant profiles against a regression prompt suite and produces a confidence band; and add an automated staged rollout that can pause or rollback to FP32 based on configurable thresholds.

Non-goals: this ticket does not implement new quant kernels or low-level runtime optimizations. It targets catalog metadata, validation orchestration, and rollout automation only.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entries for a model include immutable provenance fields: quant_pipeline_sha, calibration_dataset_sha256, calibration_sample_counts, calibration_seed, artifacts_s3_url
Shadow validation job runs as a nightly pipeline and stores per-prompt accuracy deltas and token-level mismatch rates in the evaluation DB
Rollout policy supports: canary (1%), regional ramp (25/50/100), pause-on-threshold-exceed, and automated rollback to last-known-good profile
Grafana dashboard exposes: token-accuracy-delta, top-10 failing prompts, latency-p50/p95 changes, and model-fingerprint drift
A documented runbook for incidents when quant rollout causes >2% absolute degradation on high-importance prompt set
Unit and e2e tests for the provenance schema, the shadow harness runner, and the rollback decision logic exist and pass in CI
technical_notes: Provenance schema will be appended to model catalog records as flat fields so indexers and downstream services can query without joins: quant_pipeline_sha (string), calibration_dataset_sha256 (string), calibration_sample_counts (stringified CSV), calibration_seed (string), artifacts_s3_url (string)

Shadow harness will use 3 sampling strata: (1) high-frequency production prompts, (2) curated regression prompts for safety-critical flows, (3) adversarial / stress set. Each stratum has configurable sampling weights.

Validation metrics: token_mismatch_rate (per-token), answer_fidelity_score (string compare + normalized edit distance), perplexity_delta (log-prob delta), latency_delta_ms. Decision function combines weighted metrics into a single 'confidence_band' score.

Rollout gating thresholds (initial): confidence_band >= 0.95 for canary promotion; pause if token_mismatch_rate increases by >1.5x baseline OR answer_fidelity_score drops by >2% absolute for priority prompt set; auto-rollback if any high-sev customer route shows >2% degradation for 1 hour.

Shadow-run infra: runner in CI (quick smoke), daily scheduled job on dataflow cluster for full suite, and ad-hoc run via console. Results persisted to eval-db table with columns flattened for easy querying.

To minimize false positives, we will compute 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for metrics across the sampled prompts and require statistically significant degradation before automated rollback triggers.
Calibration sampling: prefer stratified sampling by token-length and prompt-category; keep deterministic seed in provenance for reproducibility; save calibration histograms for later inspection.

Rollback implementation: store last-known-good profile id in catalog metadata. Rollback operation will create a new catalog revision that points to the previous profile and triggers a controlled re-deploy to affected routes.
Authorization: rollout/rollback APIs scoped under RBAC role 'catalog-release-engineer'—managed by the console team (separate ticket).
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 wks): Define provenance fields, update catalog schema, and add write paths in model onboarding flow
Phase 2 (2 wks): Implement shadow-validation runner and baseline nightly job; wire evaluation persistence
Phase 3 (1 wk): Build simple canary rollout controller with pause/rollback hooks; integrate with existing deployment router
Phase 4 (1 wk): Add Grafana dashboards and alerting, finalize thresholds after 1 week of telemetry
Phase 5 (ongoing): Tune sampling, thresholds, and CI gating based on results; handoff runbook to SRE and oncall
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy telemetry causing false rollbacks. Mitigation: require statistical significance and multiple metric corroboration before automated rollback.
Risk: calibration dataset drift over time. Mitigation: store dataset fingerprints, schedule periodic re-calibration, and surface dataset-age as a catalog field.
Risk: rollout automation bug triggering mass rollback. Mitigation: manual approval gate for >10% traffic changes and 'dry-run' mode for first 2 production promotions.
Risk: added catalog fields increase index size. Mitigation: keep provenance fields lightweight (strings), and offload large artifacts to S3 links only.
